sources.ref: TANCHJIM Android app 2.5.7.4 (com.tanchjim.android): the device table and how it finds a device by USB vendor and product id

meta.notes: The app reads the USB id a device keeps in flash (0x0D at a chip-specific address) only to recover one that comes up as 0x0666:0x0888 after a failed update; its table gives no product id of its own for the Space Pro AT (any other 0x3302 id), so it is matched by name under Walkplay's vendor id.
